messages:
tara: Quick POC recap w/ AltAI — they want a near-zero-change swap. Big asks: exact prompt->response shape, identical token tallies for billing during the 90d trial, and deterministic fallbacks. Sharing notes + owners.

ben: Tech gaps we saw: AltAI strips trailing spaces and converts CRLF->LF before tokenizing, and their streaming sends ~64B chunks. Our tokenizer counts CRLF as extra token in some edge cases; streaming chunk sizes differ. Can build an adapter to mirror their preproc and a stream chunker flag.

li: Example shim I prototyped to normalize:
```python
import re
def altai_normalize(s):
    s = s.replace('\r\n','\n')
    s = re.sub(r'\n{3,}', '\n\n', s)
    s = s.rstrip(' ')
    return s
```
That matches AltAI for 98% of our corpus.

gwen: Security/legal: they need SOC2 + written retention policy + customer KMS support on Dedicated. Also asked for an API to purge logs and a signed deletion receipt. @ops-bot can you confirm deletion API name?

ops-bot: ops-bot: endpoint available -> DELETE /v1/audit/logs/{session_id} returns 202 + deletion_receipt_id. Audit trail stored for 90 days per tenant policy.

ben: Streaming parity option: add query param `stream_chunk_bytes=64` and `stream_nodelay=true` in the adapter; also a `compat-mode=altai` flag that applies normalization and chunk hints.

li: Token billing proposal: two paths — (A) adapter normalizes so our counts = their counts during POC, or (B) fixed POC price + reconciliation. Ops: which is simpler?

gwen: Legal prefers reconciliation clause. Suggested: fixed POC per-1k rate, with credit if validated delta >5% over 30-day rolling. Need SOW language and sign-off.

tara: Sales preference: match counts in adapter for trial (less churn) and include reconciliation clause as backup. Also buyer requested a sample diff report before next call.

ben: I'll run a 250-prompt harness (their top intents + edgecases) and produce side-by-side token counts + response diffs. Will include examples where quantized model flavors change tokenization. ETA tomorrow EOD.

li: Note: when we normalize, watch out for system prompting differences — AltAI treats a leading \"system:\" line as part of user content if not wrapped in special header. Adapter must map system->system role explicitly.

gwen: Security Qs pending: IP allowlist for control plane, SAML SSO via SCIM, KMS key rotation policy, and retention SLA. I'll draft answers and attach.

ops-bot: ops-bot: artifact published -> /altai_poc/harness_report_v1.csv :white_check_mark:

ben: Action items:
- ben: run harness + upload diff report (tomorrow EOD)
- gwen: complete security questionnaire answers + deletion API sample receipt (EOD today)
- tara: draft POC SOW (include compat flag + reconciliation clause) and outbound mail (tomorrow morning)
- li: add compat-mode flag to staging adapter and enable stream_chunk_bytes (ops to toggle)

li: Quick adapter snippet for clients:
```http
POST /v1/compat?mode=altai&stream_chunk_bytes=64&compat_nodelay=1
{
  \"role_map\": \"actor->role\",
  \"preserve_trace\": true
}
```
This will normalize input, preserve trace_id->x-request-id, and emit smaller frames.

tara: Scheduled follow-up Thurs 11am PT to review harness diffs and SOW. Thanks team.
